warning_texts: The reported period ends on 2025-03-30 as the spec states, yet metrics/calculated_metrics.json labels it 2025-Q1-delivered; no raw row is dated 2025-03-31, so no figure changes, but a reader may take the label as the full calendar quarter.

No rule in audit/check_plan.json inspects caveat text for claims beyond the required topics, so an unsupported comparison written into a caveat passes every machine gate; auditor judgment is the only check there.

The refund rate on the paying-customer basis (0.473684) is about 2.5 times the order-row reading (0.189655 = 33/174); the claim states its basis in words, and any surface that prints it without that caveat would mislead.
summary: All five registered claim values match an independent recalculation from raw_data/orders.csv (net revenue 35741.52 EUR, refund rate 0.473684 on 27 of 57 paying customers, PL/DE/CZ 11181.67/11032.61/13527.24 summing to the headline), and the populations, periods and refund basis are stated correctly. One blocker: CLM-NET-REVENUE carries a quarter-over-quarter growth figure in its caveats that has no metric, no claim binding and no data behind it, because the export holds no order dated before 2025-01-01.
